task_description.overview: Create a SeismoStats Catalog object from a CSV file.
steps: Import Catalog class from seismostats module.
Load the CSV using Pandas read_csv() function.
Call Catalog(df) to create the Catalog object.
Use .head() to preview the first entries.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Create a SeismoStats Catalog from different methods. Loading catalog from a CSV file {csv_path}, and then create the Catalog object. Plot a figure to show the catalog spatial distribution, and then save the Catalog to a csv file. Save the figure to {catalog_plot} and the csv file to {catalog_file}.
